The repair (phase-7-backend-release.r2.json root_cause.fix) must move all 8 files together, because ReportPreview.tsx imports ./ReportSheet and ReportSheet.tsx imports ./ReportSheetCharts. This unit owns only ReportSheet.tsx and BrandSection.tsx of the affected files. The other files are owned as follows: ReportCenterPage, ReportDelivery, ReportPreview, ReportSheetCharts and useReportPreview by phase-1-frontend-report-center; ReportOptions and PortfolioReportPage by phase-2-frontend-evolution-portfolio (with phase-1-frontend-report-center); src/App.tsx by phase-2-frontend-evolution-portfolio (also phase-1-frontend-company-tabs, phase-3-frontend-actions, phase-4-frontend-diary); src/features/result/ResultPage.tsx by phase-1-frontend-result (also phase-3-frontend-actions). Moving only ReportSheet.tsx would break ReportPreview.tsx, and re-implementing the cover inside BrandSection.tsx would still leave App.tsx and ResultPage.tsx importing the dropped folder. So no local patch fixes the store build, and no file was changed.
`node scripts/smoke-store-package.mjs` was not rerun. It stops at step 1/8 until the rename lands, and the rename is outside this unit's files.
Capability-wide checks remain for integration: `pnpm exec playwright test tests/e2e/brand.spec.ts`, and the Play dev-link walkthrough (save a PNG logo and a JPG logo, then export the three PDFs).

A plain `pnpm typecheck` exits 1 here before tsc runs. pnpm's deps-status check starts `pnpm install`, and the postinstall `prisma migrate deploy` fails with 'database is locked' on data/fitpulse.db, probably because a running preview holds the database. `pnpm --config.verify-deps-before-run=false typecheck` (which runs tsc --noEmit) exits 0.

messages.text: The fix for AC-ra-54 needs one atomic cross-unit change that no single frontend unit owns. (1) Move all 8 files from src/features/reports/ to src/features/report-center/ (PortfolioReportPage.tsx, ReportCenterPage.tsx, ReportDelivery.tsx, ReportOptions.tsx, ReportPreview.tsx, ReportSheet.tsx, ReportSheetCharts.tsx, useReportPreview.ts). Their relative imports stay valid. (2) Update the 3 importers: src/App.tsx:12 (owner phase-2-frontend-evolution-portfolio), src/features/result/ResultPage.tsx:23 (owner phase-1-frontend-result / phase-3-frontend-actions) and src/features/settings/BrandSection.tsx:13 (owner phase-2-frontend-brand). Change '@/features/reports/' to '@/features/report-center/'. Also check src/App.tsx for an import of ReportCenterPage. (3) Delete src/features/reports/. (4) Run `pnpm --config.verify-deps-before-run=false typecheck`, `pnpm build`, then `node scripts/smoke-store-package.mjs` (expect 8/8, about 5 minutes). Owners of the moved files: phase-1-frontend-report-center (ReportCenterPage, ReportDelivery, ReportPreview, ReportSheet, ReportSheetCharts, useReportPreview, plus the first version of ReportOptions) and phase-2-frontend-evolution-portfolio (ReportOptions, PortfolioReportPage). This unit may change only ReportSheet.tsx and BrandSection.tsx, and moving those alone breaks ReportPreview.tsx.

Plain `pnpm typecheck` / `pnpm build` can fail before running. pnpm's verify-deps triggers `pnpm install`, and its postinstall runs `prisma migrate deploy` on data/fitpulse.db, which fails with 'database is locked' while a preview holds the database. Use `--config.verify-deps-before-run=false`, or stop the preview first.

Still open from r0: `pnpm exec playwright test tests/e2e/brand.spec.ts` and the Play dev-link walkthrough (PNG and JPG logos, the three PDFs with the brand). The selectors are listed in phase-2-frontend-brand.json.
